items.headline: Muon in Associative Memory Learning: Training Dynamics and Scaling Laws
items.summary:
arXiv:2602.05725v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Muon updates matrix parameters via the matrix sign of the gradient and has shown strong empirical gains, yet its dynamics and scaling behavior remain unclear in theory.
